{{Quote|The Empire is willing to pay a considerable fee for disposing of defenses orbiting Ilum.''"<br />"''Is my target one of the filthy pirates in that sector?''"<br />"''Your target is the defenses, the Imperial fleet will take care of the rest.|Darth Vader and Boba Fett|<ref name="eaw2" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]] in an effort to discover the identity of an Imperial traitor who attempted to jeopardize the Empire's operations on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. After the location of the pirates was confirmed by a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]], the Empire hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to scout out the pirate base and destroy their early warning systems. Fett succeeded in the task and an Imperial task force was brought in to attack the pirate asteroid base to root out the [[Unidentified pirate leader (Ilum)|leader]], who attempted to escape aboard an [[Interceptor-class frigate/Legends|''Interceptor''-class frigate]]. Eventually, however, the pirate ship was neutralized and boarded, and the leader was taken away to be interrogated.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Fondor has been subjugated. Have you intercepted any information about our traitor?''"<br />"''We have deciphered encoded transmissions which were redirected several times, but eventually routed to Ilum.''"<br />"''The pirates' den, no doubt. Send a probe droid to confirm this&hellip;infestation.|Darth Vader and a stormtrooper|<ref name="eaw2" />}}
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] invaded<ref name="eaw1">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''&mdash;Imperial campaign, Mission 01</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]&mdash;controlled by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="eaw1" />&mdash;the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] suspected that someone had warned the Rebels of their approach. [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] insignias found on Rebel equipment led Vader to the conclusion that the Alliance was co-operating with the pirates, trading information on Imperial [[Hyperspace route/Legends|cargo routes]] in exchange for supplies.<ref name="eaw1" /> However, his investigation was interrupted by the news of a Rebel [[Invasion of Fondor|uprising]] on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-producing world of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Vader thus ordered his forces to eliminate the threat and recover any communications they discover. After the uprising was suppressed,<ref name="eaw2" /> the Empire intercepted coded transmissions that eventually led to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|Do not overestimate your value to the Empire, Fett. But your services are required here. Our target is the pirate leader, and he will be taken alive.|Darth Vader to Boba Fett|<ref name="eaw2" />}}
[[File:Fett_illum.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] approaching the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base.]]

The planet had heavy defenses installed, so Vader hired [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to use his stealth skills as the pilot of the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] to slip through their defenses and destroy the sensor pods, allowing the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to move in.

With this done, the Imperial fleet was free to pursue the pirate leader, who tried to escape in his [[Interceptor-class frigate/Legends|Pirate interceptor cruiser]]. Boba Fett hit a blow to the pirate's engines before he could jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and the leader surrendered himself.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Begin your interrogation immediately, Fett. This pirate may know the identity of the traitor we seek.|Darth Vader to Boba Fett|<ref name="eaw2" />}}
Their leader supplied the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with more information on Moff Kalast.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was the third mission of the Imperial campaign in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.

The strength and composition of the imperial force may vary at the player's wish, only the Probe droid and Slave I (Boba Fett's starship) are mandatory in this mission. Attaching Darth Vader (who pilots the TIE Advanced) to the imperial fleet is optional.
